title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_dropped}
description: Phase 8 §8.5 — notification emitted by maint.dlq.v1 when a replay request is refused for a non-deny / non-escalation reason (rate-limited, malformed, etc.). Operator surface for diagnostic visibility distinct from `dlq_escalated` (which is request-level) and `dlq_topic_disabled_drained` (which is topic-level).
